title:
Author THERMITE.skill.md v2 — the agent-facing skill for the Stage-1 forge tier (umbrella .design/thermite2-program.md REQ-8 / AC-13). ENVIRONMENT (use directly, do not probe external files): Verus at /Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus (export VERUS_BIN=/Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus + add dir to PATH); lake at /Users/maxine/.elan/bin.

THERMITE.skill.md is GENERATED by the thermite-skill crate (NOT hand-edited) and is gated by a 6,000-token budget (CI: cargo run -p thermite-skill -- --check-budget). 'v2' means: update the thermite-skill GENERATOR to emit the new agent-facing Stage-1 content, then regenerate THERMITE.skill.md, staying UNDER the 6,000-token budget. Ground everything in the SHIPPED code on main.

Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit. STANDING SELF-VERIFY: python3 tooling/doc-drift.py (re-pin any design doc whose governed source you touch) + tooling/reqs check; finish 0-drift.

SCOPE: THERMITE.skill.md v2 ONLY (NOT the §6 metrics dashboard, NOT the README headline flip). Add/refresh, derived from shipped Stage-1 features:
1. THE SEVEN VERDICTS (Proved/Counterexample/RealWitness/CovenantRefuted/Stuck/KernelBudget/Timeout): what each means to an agent + what to do (Stuck → add a missing simp bridge from the frozen battery; CovenantRefuted → the falsify counterexample shows the bug; RealWitness → postcondition false over reals, escalated).
2. ROUTING / ENGINE REASONS: relaxable polynomial → nlsat L4; in-cage → verus L3; lemma/proof → lean; reading the per-clause engine/trust/verdict attribution.
3. COVENANT AUTHORING: how to write witness { inhabit (...); falsify N; } (>=1 author inhabit), covenant-before-burn, what falsify does.
4. FORGE-TIER VERBS: forge goal --proof, forge fill <item> ?pN, proof for / lemma, the burn receipt. (Do NOT cover the stage-2 restratify recipe — forward-looking, not shipped.)

Keep curated prose minimal; the budget gate is hard. If v2 content would blow the 6,000-token budget, TIGHTEN existing prose to fit — do NOT exceed the budget or weaken the gate.

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo run -p thermite-skill -- --check-budget MUST pass (<6,000 tokens); cargo test -p thermite-skill; clippy -p thermite-skill --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; doc-drift 0-drift; tooling/reqs check clean; if committed_skill_is_fresh pins the generated file, regenerate so it matches. No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: register the skill-v2 deliverable in .design/reqs/registry.toml with typed evidence, or note under umbrella REQ-8.

SCOPE GUARDS: do NOT flip the README headline; no cage/combinator-menu change; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. git push is blocked — commit locally, end with a clear summary, the orchestrator pushes. One branch.
